meta.vs30Method: Wald & Allen (2007) stable-continent slope proxy; central differences of ±30″ arm-mean elevations
meta.elevationSource: Open Topo Data srtm90m (NASA SRTM 3 arc-second), 5-point cross means per 30″ arm; Open-Meteo GLO-90 fallback
meta.note: Reference-condition (Vs30 = 760 m/s) mapped values; NOT amplified. Site class is an estimate at ~5 km resolution. pzElev/kElev: top of Paleozoic and top of Cretaceous, m relative to sea level, interpolated from Dart (1995) and Cushing et al. (1964) structure contours via Smout (2025); null where not contoured.
meta.subsurfaceSource: Smout, B., 2025, USGS data release doi:10.5066/P14BV2PI, digitizing Dart 1995 (USGS MF-2284) and Cushing et al. 1964 (USGS PP 448-B)
